title: Stage F failures during this round are host-load timing flakes, not a regression
subtitle: colima VM (2 vCPU) on a host at load average 45-150; rig OPERATION_LEASE = DISPATCH_LEASE = 2 s

blocks.label: adoptedWorkerCanCancelItsOriginalActiveCall: round-2 vs round-3 heads alternated, then 2 s vs 10 s dispatch lease
blocks.pre:
== round-2 head 7236322a43 : 8/10, 9/10, 10/10      round-3 head 36f87cd0e6 : 10/10, 10/10, 8/10
== 2 s lease : 2/2, 1/2, 2/2      ++ 10 s lease : 2/2, 2/2, 2/2
== cause: cancelExecution fences a lapsed claim and sends no transport.cancel; the restarted Broker must cancel
==        within the 2 s dispatch lease, which a slow host misses

blocks.note: Every failure is a timing symptom of the 2 s leases (runtime_provision_fenced, 'cancellation must reach the original active worker', '5 commit attempts'). It also hits main without this PR, and none recurred with 5-10 s leases. These gates are not in CI; a longer lease for the durable gates would keep them usable as release gates on slower hosts.
